rule.comment: Typically, SharePoint is configured to authenticate users to an LDAP Domain. If this is the case, the user should already exist in the LDAP Domain before being synchronized to SharePoint. This rule checks for an LDAP driver association as a prerequisite to synchronizing the user to the SharePoint site collection.

arg-string.token-text: Vetoed the add because there is no association for the LDAP driver "$drv-ldap-driver-dn$"
